mitigation_strategy: Doc/license.rst inspection confirms all third-party licenses are permissive and compatible

mitigation_strategy: Multi-tier regex and spaCy NER scrubbing pipeline
owner_review_requirement: Owner review of conversational PII boundaries

mitigation_strategy: Automated length filtering and Apache-2.0 Section 7 warranty disclaimer
owner_review_requirement: Owner acceptance of contributor risk profile
